title: On the Body page, your own entries can be tapped to fix or delete but look exactly like the trainer's entries, which cannot
what: In the list under the graph, each of the member's own weigh-ins and measurements opens a fix-or-delete sheet when tapped, but the row has no arrow, pencil or other sign. The trainer's rows look the same and do nothing. A first-time member has no way to see that a wrong weigh-in can be fixed from here.
expected: Rows that open something show a clear sign (for example an arrow or pencil), and rows that do nothing look different.
fix_line: Add a small arrow or pencil to the member's own rows

title: The note about a wrong link on the Workout tab can only be closed by tapping it, with nothing showing that
what: When a broken app link lands on the Workout tab, a plain grey card explains it. Tapping the card closes it, but there is no close mark, so sighted members do not know how to get rid of it (a screen reader does hear Dismiss).
expected: The note shows a visible close mark or button.
fix_line: Add a small close mark to the note

title: When importing from Hevy or Strong, a screen reader does not say which choice (add to or replace) is picked
what: The two import choices are large cards. The picked one turns orange with a tick, but the screen reader is not told they are buttons or which one is selected, so a blind member may start a replace without knowing it.
expected: Each choice is read out as a choice, with selected or not selected.
fix_line: Tell the screen reader each card is a choice and which is picked

title: The Got it button on the Profile tab note looks like plain grey text
what: The note saying progress now lives in Profile has a Got it control drawn in the same grey as normal text, with no button shape or orange colour, so it does not look like something to tap.
expected: Got it looks like a button or link (the app's orange link colour or a button shape).
fix_line: Draw Got it in the link colour or as a small button
